'''Troy Donelly''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Auckland tournament]] on 18 November 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court with Hutt Influence]], according to Luke Badger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1485">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-21-auckland-new-zealand-november-18d1485/ auckland-new-zealand-november-18], DeckTech (Luke "Lukisius" Badger, 21 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-21-auckland-new-zealand-november-18d1485/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
